Project Scope

The John Brown Juvenile Justice Center located at 5100 Second St. NW is undergoing design of a new courtroom. Bernalillo County in partnership with Studio Southwest Architects’ are designing the addition of a new 3276 SF courtroom to meet the needs of the Second Judicial District Court. The courtroom will be located in the existing footprint of the building located on the first floor just north of the existing courtrooms. The $1.2 million renovation is  schedule to start in early 2020. 

General Project Information

Status – Design completed with Studio Southwest Architects
Project Manager – Richard Romero
Construction – early 2020
Contractor – RFB
Construction Cost – $1.2 million

Project Scope

Bernalillo County’s Youth Service Center located at 5100 Second St. NW will be undergoing renovations in early 2020 to improve the aging conditions of the facility. The facility was erected in the mid 70’s and has gone through several additions as well as major tenant improvements. The goals of the project are to decrease violence and self-harm and keep both residence and staff safe. The $1.6 million renovation will focus upon code and aesthetic improvements, security enhancements and building system improvements.

 

General Project Information

Status – In design with Vigil & Associates Architects
Project Manager – Richard Romero
Construction – Early 2020
Contractor – RFB
Construction Cost – $1.6 million
